ValidationRule.description: Source of Wealth and Actual Estimated Net Wealth Mandatory for EDD Cases If customer is PEP
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), RecordType.DeveloperName = "On_Boarding", ISPICKVAL(Type, "EDD"), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "All Documents Uploaded"), OR( PEP_Customer__c = true, Customer_Risk_Rating__c = 'Restricted', Customer_Risk_Rating__c = 'High' ), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Source_of_Wealth__c)), ISBLANK(Actual_or_Estimated_net_wealth__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Source of Wealth and Actual or Estimated Net Wealth Fields are mandatory for PEP Customers
